rules.answers: up to 5 answers per item: the scored run's answer (at the models file's temperature), then the repeat runs' answers at the provider's default temperature, oldest first
rules.spread: (max − min) / min of the calorie answers, in percent; Infinity when the smallest is 0 and another is not
rules.differs: spread over 10%, over the items with at least 2 calorie answers
rules.small_values: USDA under 10 kcal: answers no more than 5 kcal apart agree (spread 0)
rules.kcal_within_10_of_usda: share of all answers within ±10% of USDA under the scoring rules; an answer without calories counts against it
